metadata.track_name: Implement SPL(Java) flow control in TypeScript (spl-flow)
metadata.goal: Add grid-based flow execution and SPL control-flow statements (if/for/break/continue/goto/func/return/result/end/try) to packages/spl-flow, aligning behavior with Java SPL while keeping Web-IDE's no-leading-'=' input style.

phase.name: Spec & Design Lock
phase.description: Lock the exact SPL subset and the TypeScript compatibility rules.

task.name: Confirm supported statements + exclusions
task.description: Confirm the exact statement set in-scope: if/elseif/else, for (n/range/sequence/while), break/continue, goto, func/return/result/end, try. Explicitly exclude fork/reduce/channel.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spec explicitly lists in-scope statements and excludes fork/reduce/channel.
Spec includes scenarios for each in-scope statement, including a decision to support #<cellRef> loop sequence syntax.

subtask.name: Write spec scenarios for each statement
Decide if '#A1' loop-seq syntax is in scope

task.name: Confirm grid + no-leading-'=' compatibility rules
task.description: Define how TS flow treats plain cells (default expression) and whether to accept Java-style '='/'>' prefixes as optional compatibility.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spec defines plain cell handling (default expression) and explicitly accepts leading '=' and '>' prefixes without requiring them.
Spec defines comment cell skipping and includes compatibility scenarios.

phase.name: Flow Program Model
phase.description: Introduce cell model + classification + grid index (no behavior changes yet).

task.name: Add cell classification + grid index
task.description: Build a normalized grid representation from FlowCell[] and classify cells as blank/comment/expression/command.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: FlowGrid normalizes row/col into cellRef and can lookup by cellRef or (row,col).
Cells are classified as blank/comment/expression/command with correct normalization (prefix stripping, else-if mapping, continue keyword).

task.name: Enforce TS dialect row constraints
task.description: Enforce TypeScript dialect constraints: - Only `//` starts a comment cell; single '/' is not a comment. - A comment cell truncates the rest of the row (cells to its right are ignored). - After truncation, at most one non-blank, non-comment cell may exist per row.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `//` is the only comment marker and truncates the row to the right.
Evaluation fails with a clear error when multiple executable cells exist in the same row.

phase.name: Execution Engine Core
phase.description: Port PgmCellSet-style navigation (cur position, setNext, block boundary, stack).

task.name: Implement getCodeBlockEndRow + setNext
task.description: Implement indentation-scoped blocks and deterministic navigation across row/col while skipping blank/comment cells.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: getCodeBlockEndRow closes blocks only on non-blank/non-comment cells at same-or-less indentation.
setNext skips blank/comment cells and advances deterministically across row/col.

subtask.name: Write failing tests for block boundary

task.name: Preserve backward-compatible sequential behavior
task.description: Ensure flows without any command cells behave like the current implementation (same scope + lastQuery behavior).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Flows without command cells still evaluate sequentially and preserve scope + lastQuery behavior.
Command parsing does not break expression calls like if(...); optional leading '='/'>' prefixes are accepted.

phase.name: If / ElseIf / Else
phase.description: Implement conditional branching in the row-unique dialect (multi-row branches + indented blocks).

task.name: Implement if/elseif/else dispatch
task.description: Add command parsing and execution for if/elseif/else, including branch search and skip rules.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Multi-row if/elseif/else selects the first matching branch and skips the rest.
Same-row if/else form is supported and non-taken branch cells are not evaluated (scope remains unset).
Both 'elseif' and 'else if' forms are accepted.

subtask.name: Write failing tests for if-else chains

task.name: Align if/elseif/else to row-unique dialect
task.description: Drop same-row if/else chains. Require one executable statement per row (excluding `//` comments) and use multi-row branches + indented blocks.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: if/elseif/else works using multi-row, indented-block form only.
Same-row branch forms are rejected by the row-unique validation.

phase.name: For / Break / Continue
phase.description: Implement loop variants and loop-control statements.

task.name: Implement for loop variants
task.description: Support for (infinite), for n, for start,end[,step], for sequenceExpr, for conditionExpr.

subtask.name: Write failing tests for each loop variant

task.name: Implement break/continue with optional target
task.description: Support break/continue on nearest loop and break/continue targeting outer loop by cellRef.

task.name: Implement goto cellRef jump
task.description: Implement goto and enforce safety rules (no jump into deeper indentation / loop body).

phase.name: Subroutines + Result/End
phase.description: Implement func (subroutines)/return/result/end; support func(masterCell, ...) invocation semantics.

task.name: Implement func subroutine invocation
task.description: Implement SPL subroutine semantics: - A "func" command cell is a subroutine master cell; its body is the indented block. - The subroutine body does not execute during normal top-level flow execution. - Invoke as func(A1, x1, x2, ...) where A1 is a cellRef literal. - On invocation, assign x1..xn into cells starting at A1 and moving right (A1,B1,C1,...), then execute the block until return or block end. - If no return executes, return the last expression-cell value inside the subroutine block.

subtask.name: Write failing tests for func + return

task.name: Implement result/end flow termination
task.description: Implement result to terminate flow with a value; implement end to terminate with optional error message.

phase.name: Try
phase.description: Implement SPL-style try blocks with error capture semantics.

task.name: Implement try block + error capture
task.description: Capture errors thrown within try block execution, store message into the try cell, and continue after the block.
